names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 13 octombrie.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 13 Οκτωβρίου, «Άγιοι Κάρπος, Πάπυλος, Αγαθόδωρος και Αγαθονίκη», with the rank word left off; the page's own heading for this one is «Αγιος Καρπος».

The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 1175, «Святитель Карп Фиатирский, Пергамский, епископ, сщмч.», with the rank words and the office left off. It keeps both epithets; the day line gives «Карпа, еп. Фиатрийского».

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 13. октобар ст. ст., „Св. муч. Карп и Папила.“ — «Св.» is "saint" and not a rank and «муч.» is the martyr grade this corpus keeps in `types`, so both come off and the bare personal name, the first of the heading’s two, is the whole of the form; the heading gives neither man an epithet, and the see in the body stays in `office` where this folder already keeps it. `foldchk.py` returns `carpus-the-apostle` for this exact string, so the form folds onto the apostle of the Seventy and the fold is recorded in `scripts/corpus-gate.mjs`.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 13 октября ст. ст. — «Мчч. Карпа, еп. Фиатрийского, Папилы диакона, Агафодора и мц. Агафоники (251).»
source.note: The rank is the alt text of the icon standing immediately before this line, «Cовершается служба, не отмеченная в Типиконе никаким знаком» — a service the Typikon marks with no sign at all. The day's other icon is a polyeleos, «Совершается служба с полиелеем», and it stands immediately before the line of the Iveron icon of the Theotokos, which is that line's alone and does not reach any later one.

attestations.note: The Russian keeps the four together on 13 October, as the Greek and the Romanian do, and gives the year neither of them gives, 251. Its life has him and Papylas reported to the governor for staying away from the pagan feasts, and it is the governor who first argues the truth of the Roman religion with them before the torture starts. Its index page adds Pergamum to Thyatira as his second epithet.

source.text: doxologia.ro, calendarul zilei pentru 13 octombrie — «Sfântul Mucenic Carp»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 13ης Οκτωβρίου — «Άγιοι Κάρπος, Πάπυλος, Αγαθόδωρος και Αγαθονίκη»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 13 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same menologion day the folder already keeps for the Romanian church, and the entry is the same company: all four of Pergamon, martyred when Decius was emperor, «(249 - 251 μ.Χ.), σκληρότατος διώκτης των χριστιανών», under the proconsul Valerius, and all four beheaded. saint.gr gives the four one page with a heading each, and a separate epigram for Carpus and Papylus together, for Agathodorus and for Agathonica. The page gives no year of death, only that reign, so no `dates` object is proposed. It records relics: «Αποτμήματα του Ιερού Λειψάνου του Αγίου Πάπυλου βρίσκονται στις Μονές Σταυρονικήτα Αγίου Όρους και Τιμίου Σταυρού Σάμου», and the same for Carpus. The apolytikion names all four and is taken for all four; **the kontakion names only Καρπέ and Πάπυλε and is taken only for those two**, although it stands on the page of all four — it is the company's own service and not a mis-hang, but it is not drafted onto a saint it does not name. The Μεγαλυνάριον, which does name all four, and the Οἶκος are neither a troparion nor a kontakion and are not drafted. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page. **For the writer: the page gives Carpus a see — «είχε γίνει επίσκοπος Θυατείρων» — and `upgrade.py` has no key for `office`, so it is left to be placed by hand.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 26.10.2026 (13. октобар ст. ст.) — „Св. муч. Карп и Папила.“

attestations.note: The day’s first entry, and the heading is an ENUMERATED COMPANY OF TWO — Карп and Папила — so BRIEF-SERBIAN section 5 counts two names, two folders are owed a row, and the corpus holds both. The heading is quoted whole, with the closing full stop the Prologue itself prints: section 4 asks for the line as the book sets it, and `.tmp/srbody.mjs` no longer strips that stop. The quoted line is the one heading, whole, on both rows. TWO PEOPLE THE BODY NAMES AND NEITHER GETS A ROW. Агатодор, Carpus’s servant, who followed his master the whole way in grief until he too was taken for torture, and Агатоника, Papylas’s sister, who leapt into the furnace after them — `agathodorus-servant-of-carpus-and-papylas` and `agathonica-sister-of-papylas` are both in this corpus and both are already venerated on this same menologion day in the Russian, Romanian and Greek calendars. NEITHER IS NAMED IN THIS HEADING, and section 4 and section 5 make the heading the test, not the body: a person narrated in a body but not enumerated in the heading gets no row from this source. They are named and linked in the prose instead, which costs nothing, because all four folders already relate one another in both directions. WHAT THE BOOK ADDS. The governor is named Валерије and the reign is Декијево. Both men were Pergamenes by birth; Carpus was bishop of Thyatira and Papylas his deacon; they were tied to horses and driven to Sardis, tormented there, HEALED OF THEIR WOUNDS BY AN ANGEL OF GOD WHO STRENGTHENED THEM, then tied to horses again and dragged back to Pergamum. CARPUS LAUGHED under the scourging that turned his whole body into one wound, and told those who asked why that he saw the heavens opened and the Lord seated on his throne with the cherubim and the seraphim about him. PAPYLAS HEALED A MAN BLIND IN ONE EYE by prayer in the middle of his own torture, and many who saw it believed. The beasts left them unharmed, the furnace did not scorch them, and they were beheaded at the last. `dates` UNTOUCHED: the entry closes «Најзад их све мачем посекоше, 251. год.» and both folders already hold `death` 251 exactly, so there is nothing to widen and nothing to narrow. `types` untouched — «муч.» is the `martyr` both hold, «епископ Тијатирски» is the `bishop` and the `office` Carpus holds, and «ђакон» is the `deacon` Papylas holds. No `office` change: «епископ Тијатирски» says again what `Bishop of Thyateira` already says. No `locations`: Pergamum, Sardis and Thyatira are named and none of them is a coordinate. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion; the day carries only Bishop Nikolai’s verse, which is on Злата. THE FOLD THIS FORM MAKES: `foldchk.py` measured «Карп» as held by `carpus-the-apostle` in sr — Carpus of the Seventy, the apostle, bishop and martyr kept on 26 May — so this form takes that string to two folders, and a two-folder key is in `scripts/corpus-gate.mjs` in the same commit.

hymns.text: Mucenicii Tăi, Doamne, întru nevoinţele lor, cununile nesctricăciunii au dobândit de la Tine, Dumnezeul nostru. Că având tăria Ta, pe chinuitori au învins; zdrobit-au şi ale demonilor neputincioase îndrăzniri. Pentru rugăciunile lor, mântuieşte sufletele noastre, Hristoase Dumnezeule.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfinților Mucenici Carp, Papil şi al celor împreună cu dânșii

english.text: Thy martyrs, O Lord, in their struggles received crowns of incorruption from Thee, our God; for having Thy strength they overcame their tormentors, and broke the feeble insolence of the demons also. By their prayers, O Christ God, save our souls.

hymns.text: Βίον ἔνθεον, διαδραμόντες, Χριστοῦ ὤφθητε, συγκληρονόμοι, δι' ἀθλήσεως ἐχθρὸν τροπωσάμενοι, Καρπὲ σοφὲ καὶ κλεινὲ Ἀγαθόδωρε, Ἀγαθονίκη καὶ Πάπυλε ἔνδοξε. Θεῖοι Μάρτυρες, Χριστῷ τῷ Θεῷ πρεσβεύσατε, δωρήσασθαι ἤμιν τὸ μέγα ἔλεος.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος γ’, Θείας πίστεως — the first hymn on the page the four share, and it names all four of them.

english.text: Having run through a godly life, you were shown to be co-heirs of Christ, having routed the enemy by your contest: wise Carpus and renowned Agathodorus, Agathonica and glorious Papylus. Divine Martyrs, intercede with Christ our God to grant us his great mercy.

hymns.text: Ὡς θησαυρὸν πολυτελὴ ὁ Δεσπότης, καὶ κρήνην βρύουσαν κρουvοὺς ἰαμάτων, τοῖς ἐπὶ γῆς παρέσχετο τὰ λείψανα ὑμῶν, νόσους μὲv καθαίροvτα, παθημάτωv ποικίλωv, χάριν δὲ βραβεύοντα, ταῖς ψυχαῖς ἀενάως, διὸ συμφώvως Καρπὲ τὴν ὑμῶν, Πάπυλε πόθῳ, τελοῦμεv πανήγυριv.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος δ’, Ὁ ὑψωθεὶς — on the page the four share. It is addressed to the company in the plural and names Carpus and Papylus, and no saint outside the four.

english.text: As a most precious treasure and a spring welling up with streams of healings, the Master gave your relics to those on earth, cleansing diseases of every sort of suffering and awarding grace to souls unceasingly; and so with one voice, Carpus, and with longing, Papylus, we keep your festival.

hymns.text: Венченосцы явльшеся днесь в мире,/ премудрии, с Карпом Папиле,/ просвещаете всех,/ иже верою и веселием чтущих память вашу.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 13 октября ст. ст. — «Ин кондак мучеников Карпа, Папилы диакона, Агафодора и мученицы Агафоники»
source.note: The day prints a troparion and a kontakion of martyrs above it, «Мученицы Твои, Господи» and «Яко сокровище многоценное», both of which name nobody and are the common; this second kontakion is headed with all four names and is recorded for that reason.

english.text: Shown forth today in the world as crown-bearers, O most wise ones, Papylas with Carpus, ye enlighten all who honour your memory with faith and gladness.

death.note: The year days.pravoslavie.ru prints after the four names, «Мчч. Карпа, еп. Фиатрийского, Папилы диакона, Агафодора и мц. Агафоники (251)». Its life for the four gives the reign rather than the year, «во времена гонения на христиан императора Декия в III веке», and Decius reigned to 251, so the two agree. Neither doxologia.ro nor saint.gr gives a year, and this folder held none.
